summary: Complete LED Product Detail Pages testing for Brightluxx LED display showcase website. All 18 product pages (11 Indoor + 7 Outdoor) load correctly with unique hero images, Apple-style professional layout, and all required sections.

features_tested.feature: Indoor LED listing page (/indoor-led) loads with all 4 series
features_tested.details: UltraFine, ProFine, Commercial, Standard series all visible with expandable product lists

features_tested.feature: Outdoor LED listing page (/outdoor-led) loads with all 3 series
features_tested.details: OutdoorHD, OutdoorPro, Billboard series all visible with weather features

features_tested.feature: All 11 Indoor LED product detail pages load correctly
features_tested.details: Tested: P0.5, P0.7, P0.9, P1.2, P1.5, P1.8, P2.0, P2.5, P3.0, P3.9, P4.0 - All load with correct product names

features_tested.feature: All 7 Outdoor LED product detail pages load correctly
features_tested.details: Tested: P2.5, P3.0, P4.0, P5.0, P6.0, P6.67, P8.0 - All load with correct product names

features_tested.feature: Each product page displays unique hero image
features_tested.details: All 18 products have unique AI-generated hero images. Verified 11 indoor and 7 outdoor images are all different.
Product name, pitch badge (P0.5, P1.5, etc.), series label, technology badge, tagline, description, and CTAs all present

features_tested.feature: Key Specifications bento grid displays 6 specs with icons
features_tested.details: Pixel Pitch, Resolution, Brightness, Refresh Rate, Contrast, Viewing Angle displayed in grid with icons

features_tested.feature: Viewing distance visual indicator displays correctly
features_tested.details: Optimal viewing distance with progress bar and min/max values shown

features_tested.feature: Key Features section shows 4 feature cards
features_tested.details: 4 feature cards with icons, titles, and descriptions displayed
Show All/Show Less button toggles to reveal full specs table with all product details

features_tested.feature: Applications section shows all applications with checkmarks
features_tested.details: Recommended Applications section displays application tags with cyan checkmarks

features_tested.feature: Related Products section shows other products from same series
features_tested.details: P0.5 shows P0.7 and P0.9 related products, correctly filtered by series
Request Quote button has href='/contact' and successfully navigates to contact page
Home > Indoor LED > P0.5 breadcrumb structure visible and navigable

critical_code_review_comments: Data Structure: INDOOR_PRODUCTS object has 11 products (P0.5-P4.0), not 12 as mentioned in requirements. If P1.0 was expected, it's missing.
Code Quality: Product data is well-organized by series with consistent structure across all products.
Design Implementation: Apple-style layout with immersive hero, bento grid specs, and glassmorphism effects implemented correctly.
Image Loading: All 18 unique AI-generated images load from emergentagent CDN successfully.
Responsive Design: Not explicitly tested on mobile, but desktop layout works well.
context_for_next_testing_agent: LED Product Detail pages complete overhaul is fully functional. All 18 products (11 indoor, 7 outdoor) have unique hero images and professional Apple-style layouts. Key components: LEDProductDetailPage.js contains all product data and page layout, IndoorLEDPage.js and OutdoorLEDPage.js are listing pages with expandable series cards. Indoor series: UltraFine (P0.5-P0.9), ProFine (P1.2-P1.8), Commercial (P2.0-P3.0), Standard (P3.9-P4.0). Outdoor series: OutdoorHD (P2.5-P3.0), OutdoorPro (P4.0-P5.0), Billboard (P6.0-P8.0).
